app.name: Cougny
app.tagline: Meet someone new, face to face.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.acceptanceBody: By using Cougny you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms.eligibilityBody: You must be at least 18 years old to use Cougny. You confirm your age when you create an account, and an account is required to start a call.
terms.conductBody: Nudity, sexual content, harassment, hate speech, spam, and any illegal activity are strictly prohibited. Violations can lead to an immediate and permanent ban.
terms.privacyBody: Video, audio, and chat messages travel directly between you and your partner over an encrypted peer-to-peer connection. Cougny does not record, store, or monitor the content of your calls. Your partner never sees your email, your date of birth, or any other account detail.
terms.moderationBody: You can report a partner at any time. Reports are reviewed by our team and may result in restrictions or a permanent ban on the reported account.
terms.liabilityBody: Cougny is provided as-is, without warranties of any kind. You are solely responsible for your interactions with other users.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after an update constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
